links.outcome: Accuracy and fabrication rate of references cited in LLM responses
links.effect: Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Google Gemini 3 Flash had the highest proportions of accurate and relevant references (85.7% and 84.2%); DeepSeek V3.2 had the highest fabrication rate (55.6%).
links.quote: Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Google Gemini 3 Flash demonstrated the highest proportions of accurate and relevant references (85.7% and 84.2%, respectively), while DeepSeek V3.2 exhibited the highest fabrication rate (55.6%).

screen.reason: The study empirically evaluates the diagnostic, treatment planning, and citation accuracy of five commercial LLMs on restorative dentistry clinical vignettes evaluated by dental specialists, but it does not test a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
